name: Blight
description:
Choose a creature within short range. You drain moisture and vitality from it. Roll Spirit vs Fortitude. On a win, the creature takes 8d8+HEART damage. On a loss, half damage.

If you target a plant creature, its roll is ill-favored and you automatically deal maximum damage to it on a win. If you target a mundane plant, it simply withers and dies, no roll required.

Describe the blight.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: You regain Endurance equal to half the damage dealt.
